title: Circle headers read cleanly on a phone and show the Space logo whole over its picture

source.ref: Owner screenshot of Mindless Carlsbad at phone width, 2026-11-20: "We need to make these circle headers actually look good in mobile."

detail:
At phone width the Circle cover laid the status badge and the Part of <Space> pill absolutely over the title, set the name, facts and buttons in white over the cover art, and cropped the Mindless logo (its Circles saved the square logo as their image, so a wide band showed a slice of it behind the text). Buttons wrapped into uneven oversized pills.

DONE 2026-11-20 (owner: "make these circle headers actually look good in mobile", then "Needs the mindless background with the logo over it fully in screen"): every Circle cover is now a picture band (16:9, at most 280px) with the badge and Space pill on it, and the owning Space's logo drawn over the picture whole (object-fit: contain, never cropped). lib/circles/cover-art.ts picks the two: a Circle whose own image is its Space's logo gets the Space header behind and the logo on top; a Space Circle with its own photo keeps the photo with the logo over it; a personal Circle has no logo. The name, facts and buttons sit below on the kit's glass panel in the kit's ink. On a phone the primary action spans the row and QR, Edit and Manage share the next at 44px; a wide column keeps them on one row. Tabs are 40px on a phone. Rendered at 390, 1280, 1440, 1920 and 2000 with the Mindless header and logo, a photo with the logo, and no cover.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
